description: AGSC-06-06 with AGSC-06-17: every file under a version directory /ns/<major>.<minor>.<patch>/ is served with Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable, and no other address is (the unversioned /ns/context.jsonld, the namespace site's /ns/agsc.ttl, /ns/agsc.rdf, /ns/schema/** and the /ns/ index change with a release); in _headers each address pattern is written once, with the Link values of AGSC-06-40 in the one block of / and one Content-Security-Policy for /query/. The case is stated on the header set of the Cloudflare Pages profile, not on file bytes (AGSC-06-01): for each address, the headers served; for the patterns, how many blocks name each. Derived by hand from the rules.
